camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamBitRateData --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Queries the frame rates and bitrates of an RTMP live stream within a specified time range. This operation is applicable to retrieving historical data
description_zh: 查询RTMP协议的直播流在设置时间范围内的一组帧率和码率，适用于获取历史数据
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-bit-rate-data --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamBitRateData

parameters.help_en:
The ingest domain.
When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user calling this operation has the required permissions on the domain name.
You can call the DescribeLiveUserDomains operation to query available domain names
parameters.help_zh:
推流域名。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
可以通过调用 DescribeLiveUserDomains API获取可用域名列表
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the stream. You can view StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). EndTime must be later than StartTime, and the interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 EndTime要大于StartTime，并且EndTime与StartTime间隔最多为30天
parameters.name: end_time
